name: Fortified Mana Shield's Class Bonus taunt discount and non-combat damage prevention
notes: Seeds a GUARDIAN champion (Ciel, Loyal Valet) for the Class Bonus and a Dungeon Guide flagged with TAUNT, then plays Fortified Mana Shield for 0 reserve and confirms the prevention effect lands on the chosen unit.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] This card costs 2 less to activate if its activation targets a unit with taunt.
The next time target unit would take non-combat damage this turn, prevent 4 of that damage.
